SalesforceRealTimeEvents_CL.description: Salesforce Real-Time Event Monitoring events for security threat detection

columns.name: TimeGenerated
columns.description: The timestamp when the event was ingested into Microsoft Sentinel

columns.name: EventType
columns.description: Type of real-time security event (e.g., CredentialStuffingEventStore, SessionHijackingEventStore, ApiAnomalyEventStore)

columns.name: EventDate
columns.description: The timestamp when the event occurred in Salesforce

columns.name: Username
columns.description: Username of the user associated with the event

columns.name: UserId
columns.description: Salesforce User ID (15 or 18 character ID)

columns.name: SourceIp
columns.description: IP address from which the activity originated

columns.name: Score
columns.description: Risk or anomaly score (0-100) assigned by Salesforce. Higher scores indicate higher risk.

columns.name: Summary
columns.description: Human-readable summary of the security event

columns.name: SecurityEventData
columns.description: Complete JSON payload containing all event details. Structure varies by EventType.

sampleData.Summary: High-risk login from new location with previously compromised credentials
Session IP changed from trusted to suspicious location
Unusual API call volume - 10x normal rate
